name: evidence-based-paper-review-workflows
description: Evidence-driven manuscript review workflow for Codex with literature discovery, local evidence packs, multi-agent peer review, specialist audits, iteration caps, objective-limitation deferral, ML-paper writing guidance, revision, and loopback verification.

interface.shortDescription: Run a literature-evidence-driven manuscript review and revision workflow.
interface.longDescription: Installs repo-local Codex custom agents for an iterative paper review workflow. The workflow ingests a PDF or TeX source folder, infers and confirms the paper topic with the user, discovers and downloads related literature, builds an evidence map, runs an EIC/R1/R2/R3/Devil's Advocate review panel plus specialist audits for novelty, terminology, field style, professional precision, literature positioning, argument coherence, citations, and writing quality, synthesizes scores, revises the manuscript when requested, verifies the revision against evidence, and loops back under configurable iteration policies. Objective limitations such as missing experiments or unavailable raw data can be deferred after repeated attempts, and ML/AI paper writing guidance is used for narrative, citation, reproducibility, limitations, and venue-checklist revisions.
defaultPrompt: Review my paper using literature evidence.
Review the PDF or TeX source in this repository.
Infer the paper topic, ask me to confirm it, then research related papers and review.
Run evidence-based peer review and produce a revision plan.
Review and polish my manuscript using downloaded related papers.
Install evidence-based paper review workflow agents.
